peoples_entry.name: Ring Sea Islanders
peoples_entry.note: Austronesian-Polynesian & Sumba maritime peoples of the southern Ring Sea (1.93-2.0 atm; LORE.md S6.2, S6.12, S9; PROPOSAL-RING-ISLES.md): East Kautoan royal shell-mint kingdoms (hinggi ikat, tapa barkcloth, mamuli gold, coconut-coir tebutebu cuirassiers & beehive kiln-shamans), West Sikau/Hikau horned-roof kora-kora chiefdoms, exiled Hetanini courtiers & shore guerrillas, Hook Hukoa tin-tarp salvage boatwrights, and Noah's Regret Hooked-Sun Lanong freebooters (18 tiers at 100% M+F parity; tools/garments/cultures/islanders.py).
